records.title: Atom semantic search (Authoring AI draft, AnA data-room grounding) loses recall once lumen_data_atoms grows: the HNSW index is scanned first and the tenant/project filter applied after
records.evidenceAtHead: Code unchanged since 92ccdba1 (git log 92ccdba1..HEAD on db/migrations/20260730_fix_atom_embedding_dimension.sql is empty). In that file, search_atoms_hybrid (line 138), semantic_results (163-171) does `WHERE ... AND (filter_atom_ids IS NULL OR a.id = ANY(filter_atom_ids)) ORDER BY a.embedding <=> query_embedding LIMIT match_count*3` over idx_lumen_atoms_embedding_hnsw (line 83). The live caller is server/services/enhancedEmbeddingService.ts:581-592 (searchHybrid), which passes ARRAY(SELECT id FROM org_atoms). There is no hnsw.ef_search or iterative_scan setting anywhere in server/, scripts/ or migrations/ (grep: 0 hits), and local pgvector is 0.6.0. I ran the HEAD migration file in a scratch DB on local PG16 (dropped afterwards). At 5,000 rows the app path returned 10/10 for a tenant with 20 atoms, because the planner used the PK. So the audit's literal 'small tenant' claim does not reproduce on custom plans. At 50,000 rows: filters of 500/1000/2500/5000 ids (1-10% of rows) returned 1/0/1/8 of 10. The semantic arm's GENERIC plan for the 20-id tenant chose `Index Scan using idx_lumen_atoms_embedding_hnsw ... Rows Removed by Filter: 40, actual rows=0`. The searchSimilar shape (enhancedEmbeddingService.ts:434-503, caller cortexQueryRoutes.ts:305) returned 1 of 5. Launch callers: authoring.router.ts:3842 (Authoring AI draft, minSemanticScore 0.65, so keyword-only hits are dropped), data-room-retrieval.ts:61, chat/send-message.ts:319, evidence-ask.ts:212, advancedRAGPipeline.ts:771. tests/db/atom-search.dbtest.ts never forces the ANN plan. Not affected: the vault passage arm (advancedRAGPipeline.ts:1196-1262, MATERIALIZED scope-then-exact, already present at 92ccdba1), so the empty-built ivfflat on vault.document_chunks (migrations/20260905b_vault_document_chunks.sql:70-72) is unused by its reader. vault.document_catalog has no ANN index, so its search is an exact scan.
records.remaining: 1. The semantic arm of search_atoms_hybrid ranks over the HNSW index (ef_search 40) and then filters. 2. searchSimilar has the same shape. 3. Recall collapses for any tenant or project holding about 1-5% of atoms, and for every caller once plpgsql switches to its generic plan. 4. The NULL-filter branch of the function is still callable and ranks across tenants under RLS. 5. No recall test forces the ANN plan for atoms. 6. Housekeeping: the ivfflat index on vault.document_chunks was built on an empty table and is now dead weight.
records.severityRationale: A launch journey silently gets the wrong answer. Authoring's AI section draft and AnA's data-room grounding drop sources that exist, and a miss reads as 'no evidence', not as an error. It needs production-scale data (tens of thousands of atoms), which one pilot uploading an IND's worth of documents across several projects can reach. The audit's mechanism is right; its trigger was misdescribed: on custom plans it is a mid-share tenant or project that fails, while a 20-atom tenant fails only on a generic plan.
records.humanTestingNote: Testers will not see this at seed or test volumes (under about 10k atoms), because the planner does an exact scan. On a staging database with tens of thousands of atoms: an Authoring 'AI draft' of a CTD section reports zero or few retrieved sources, and AnA data-room answers cite nothing even though matching uploaded documents exist. There is no tester workaround; log it as a retrieval recall defect, not as missing data.
records.instructions:
1. Work on concept2cure-v2 only (Rule 0). Amend db/migrations/20260730_fix_atom_embedding_dimension.sql IN PLACE (Rule 1: it re-runs on every deploy). Add a dated header block, e.g. 'AMENDED IN PLACE 2026-10-xx (DATA-06): atom search scopes first, then ranks exactly; HNSW+filter returned 0-1 of 10 at 50k rows.' Do not append a new migration.
2. In search_atoms_hybrid (line 138), first statement of the plpgsql body: `IF filter_atom_ids IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'search_atoms_hybrid requires filter_atom_ids (tenant scope)' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;`. This fails closed. The only caller, enhancedEmbeddingService.searchHybrid:581-592, always passes the array.
3. Replace semantic_results (lines 163-171) with a scope-first form, mirroring advancedRAGPipeline.ts:1196-1262: `scoped AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.id, a.embedding FROM lumen_data_atoms a WHERE a.id = ANY(filter_atom_ids) AND a.embedding IS NOT NULL AND a.status = 'active' AND (filter_atom_type IS NULL OR a.atom_type = filter_atom_type)), semantic_results AS (SELECT s.id, 1 - (s.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS score FROM scoped s ORDER BY s.embedding <=> query_embedding LIMIT match_count * 3)`. Leave keyword_results and combined unchanged. The existing DROP/CREATE pair in the file already replaces the function on re-run.
4. search_atoms_semantic (line 97) has no caller in server/ (grep 'search_atoms_semantic('). Either give it the same scoped form plus a required scope argument, or stop creating it: keep its `DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS` in this same file and note the removal in the header. Before removing it, confirm that no client, AnA tool or script calls it.
5. server/services/enhancedEmbeddingService.ts searchSimilar (434-517): rewrite the query as `WITH scoped AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.* FROM lumen_data_atoms a JOIN organizations o ON a.organization_id = o.id WHERE o.uuid = $4 AND a.embedding IS NOT NULL AND <eligibility/filters>) SELECT ... FROM scoped ORDER BY embedding <=> $1 LIMIT $3`. Alternatively, move cortexQueryRoutes.ts:305 onto searchHybrid and delete searchSimilar (zero duplication); the commit must name searchHybrid as the replacement and the test that reaches it.
6. Add tests/db/atom-search-recall.dbtest.ts. Seed at least 20,000 atoms with random 1536-d vectors across two orgs: drop idx_lumen_atoms_embedding_hnsw, bulk insert, recreate the index, ANALYZE. Include (a) an org with 20 atoms and (b) an org/project holding about 2% of rows. Assert searchHybrid({limit:10}) returns 10 results with semanticScore > 0 for both, once with plan_cache_mode=force_generic_plan and once with the default. Run it against the current function first and record the failure (expected 0-1 of 10) in the commit message. Then apply steps 2-5 and show it passing.
7. Optional: the empty-built ivfflat index idx_vault_document_chunks_embedding has no reader that uses it. If you remove it, do so by amending migrations/20260905b_vault_document_chunks.sql in place (its creator), with a dated header. Run `npm run ci:migration-drop-safety` and its selftest.
8. Alternative to steps 3 and 5, once production runs pgvector 0.8 or later (see DATA-13 engine pin): `SET LOCAL hnsw.iterative_scan = strict_order` in the search transaction. The recall test in step 6 must still pass.
records.acceptance: 1. The new dbtest at 20k+ atoms FAILS on the current HEAD function: the 2%-share filter returns 0-1 of 10, and the generic plan shows `Index Scan using idx_lumen_atoms_embedding_hnsw ... Rows Removed by Filter`. 2. It PASSES after the amendment, under both plan_cache_mode settings. 3. EXPLAIN of the function's semantic arm with filter_atom_ids set shows no HNSW Order By node. 4. `SELECT search_atoms_hybrid('x', v, 0.7, 0.3, 10, NULL, NULL)` raises SQLSTATE 42501. 5. tests/db/atom-search.dbtest.ts still passes, including its cross-tenant test. 6. On a 50k-atom staging DB, an Authoring AI draft for a section whose evidence was uploaded reports sourcesRetrieved > 0. 7. ci:migration-drop-safety is green.
records.dependencies: None required. Optional: DATA-13 (production RDS engine/pgvector version), if iterative_scan is chosen instead of scope-first exact ranking.

records.title: Cross-tenant correction pooling (intelligence.ana_interactions to failure_patterns) still has no RLS and no consent. Production refuses its API through the launch-scope gate; it is fully live in non-production
records.evidenceAtHead: The pooling code is unchanged since 92ccdba1 (git log 92ccdba1..HEAD on server/services/intelligence/ana-failure-learning.ts and server/routes/regulatory-intelligence.ts is empty). extractFailurePatterns (ana-failure-learning.ts:300-345) groups correction_text across organization_id. getSuggestedCorrections (439-470) reads intelligence.failure_patterns with no organization filter. POST /patterns/extract (regulatory-intelligence.ts:303-315) accepts caller-supplied minTenantCount/minFailureCount, with no clamp against MIN_TENANT_COUNT=3 (line 35). recordInteraction stores promptSummary/responseSummary/correctionText (routes :253-287), with no consent check. scripts/db/rls-coverage-check.sql:89-95 still allowlists intelligence.ana_interactions, pattern_warnings and template_validations as a 'cross-tenant analytics carve-out', and no RLS DDL exists for them in migrations/ or db/migrations/. The router is still mounted unconditionally (server/bootstrap/register-advanced-platform-routes.ts:88-96). Production containment: shared/constants/ui-surface-registry.ui-v2.ts:828 attributes /api/regulatory-intelligence only to surface 'reg-change', which is not in LAUNCH_SURFACE_IDS (shared/constants/launch-scope.ts). I ran a tsx script against HEAD: launchScopeApiVerdict('/api/regulatory-intelligence/interactions'|'/corrections'|'/patterns/extract') returns 'out-of-scope'; readLaunchScopeMode({NODE_ENV:'production'}) returns 'on'; readLaunchScopeMode({NODE_ENV:'development'}) returns 'off'. moduleEntitlementGate refuses out-of-scope paths with 403 (moduleEntitlementGate.ts:113-117) and is mounted at server/startup/routes.ts:108, before registerAdvancedPlatformRoutes at :199. That containment already existed at 92ccdba1. Since then, .github/workflows/deploy-aws.yml:633-655 (commit 471e5a4cd, 2026-10-01) refuses a production task definition with LAUNCH_SCOPE_ENFORCE other than 'on' or set from a secret. No client code (client/src), AnA/MCP service, or scheduler calls recordInteraction, extractFailurePatterns, getSuggestedCorrections or buildPromptHints. Their only entry points are the out-of-scope routes.
records.fixedBy: No change to the pooling itself. Production containment comes from server/middleware/moduleEntitlementGate.ts:113-117 together with server/services/entitlements/launch-scope.ts:42-58 (both pre-date the audit) and the deploy guard .github/workflows/deploy-aws.yml:633-655 (471e5a4cd, post-audit).
records.remaining: 1. The database layer is unchanged: intelligence.ana_interactions holds tenant free text with RLS off, and it is explicitly allowlisted. 2. There is no per-tenant consent or opt-in. 3. Cross-tenant reads (/corrections, /templates/prompt-hints) are unscoped. 4. Any authenticated org can force promotion with minTenantCount=1. 5. The out-of-scope router is mounted and fully reachable wherever launch scope is off: every non-production environment by default, including local and staging deployments that do not set NODE_ENV=production. 6. All of this goes live in production the moment 'reg-change' enters the launch catalog. 7. Founder decision still pending on whether cross-tenant learning ships at all.
records.severityRationale: Lowered from P1. In the pilot's production deploy the HTTP surface returns 403. The default is on in production and the deploy refuses 'off'. No UI, AnA tool or job writes or reads these tables, so no pilot customer's text can reach another tenant. The remaining problem is a latent confidentiality and contract defect, plus out-of-scope surface (Rule 2) and a database table without RLS. It must be closed before enterprise GA or before reg-change is promoted. The audit overstated the production impact even at 92ccdba1, because the launch-scope gate (added 2026-09-25) already refused these paths.
records.humanTestingNote: No launch screen calls these endpoints, so click-through testers never touch them. On a local or dev deployment, launch scope is off by default (NODE_ENV not production). There, an API-level tester can POST /api/regulatory-intelligence/interactions with correctionText as tenant A, call POST /patterns/extract with {minTenantCount:1,minFailureCount:1}, and read A's text as tenant B via GET /corrections. Workaround for staging: run with NODE_ENV=production or LAUNCH_SCOPE_ENFORCE=on, which returns 403 LAUNCH_SCOPE.
records.instructions:
1. Founder: decide whether cross-tenant learning ships and under what customer contract or consent (the audit's open question). Until a yes, the code path is OFF everywhere, not only in production. Work on concept2cure-v2 (Rule 0).
2. server/routes/regulatory-intelligence.ts: add one guard ahead of the cross-tenant endpoints: POST /interactions (:253), GET /corrections (:289), POST /patterns/extract (:303), GET /agency-requirements (:317), POST /patterns/:id/promote (:330), POST /warnings/replay (:429), POST /patterns/maintenance (:448). The guard returns 404 unless env CROSS_TENANT_LEARNING === 'on'. Unset means off in every environment, and production refuses to boot on any value other than 'on'/'off', matching readLaunchScopeMode. No client or AnA caller exists (grep client/src, server/services/ana*, server/mcp), so no user-facing capability is removed. Say so in the commit and name the route test from step 7.
3. server/services/intelligence/template-registry.ts:405-415 (buildPromptHints): treat includeCorrections as false unless CROSS_TENANT_LEARNING is on. In regulatory-intelligence.ts:563, stop defaulting it to true.
4. Consent: add `cross_tenant_learning_opt_in BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE` to public.organizations through a new additive migration listed in C2C_MIGRATION_FILES (scripts/db/migration-set.mjs), inserted before the final RLS sweep pair (ci:migration-set-order). In recordInteraction (ana-failure-learning.ts:195), do not persist promptSummary, responseSummary or correctionText for orgs not opted in. In extractFailurePatterns (300-345), restrict the `failures` CTE to `organization_id IN (SELECT id FROM organizations WHERE cross_tenant_learning_opt_in)`.
5. Clamp extraction: in extractFailurePatterns, use Math.max(opts.minTenantCount ?? 0, MIN_TENANT_COUNT) and Math.max(opts.minFailureCount ?? 0, MIN_FAILURE_COUNT). Require a platform-admin role on /patterns/extract, /patterns/:id/promote and /patterns/maintenance.
6. RLS: enable and FORCE row-level security on intelligence.ana_interactions, intelligence.pattern_warnings and intelligence.template_validations, with organization_id policies matching the canonical tenant policy. Do this by amending db/migrations/20260520_ana_failure_learning.sql and 20260520_document_templates.sql in place, each with a dated header note (they are in the set at migration-set.mjs:698-699). Then remove those three entries from scripts/db/rls-coverage-check.sql:89-95. Run the cross-tenant aggregation through a SECURITY DEFINER function owned by a NOLOGIN role that returns only aggregated, opted-in rows, with `SET search_path` pinned.
7. Verify by failing first. (a) A route test: with CROSS_TENANT_LEARNING unset, POST /api/regulatory-intelligence/interactions must return 404. Show it returning 201 before the change. (b) A dbtest as app_service scoped to org A: SELECT org B's ana_interactions row must return 0 rows. Show it returning 1 before step 6. (c) Run rls-coverage-check with the allowlist entries removed: it must fail before step 6 and pass after.
records.acceptance: 1. With CROSS_TENANT_LEARNING unset, in every NODE_ENV, the seven cross-tenant endpoints return 404 and /templates/prompt-hints returns no corrections. The route test shows 201 before the change. 2. With the flag on, an org without opt-in gets no correction_text persisted and is excluded from extraction. 3. minTenantCount=1 in the request body no longer promotes a single-tenant pattern. 4. As app_service in org A, `SELECT count(*) FROM intelligence.ana_interactions WHERE organization_id = <B>` returns 0 (1 before). 5. scripts/db/rls-coverage-check.sql has no intelligence.ana_interactions, pattern_warnings or template_validations allowlist entries and passes on a fresh provision. 6. The production launch-scope verdict for /api/regulatory-intelligence stays 'out-of-scope' until the founder adds reg-change to the catalog.
records.dependencies: Founder decision and customer contract or consent language for cross-tenant learning. DATA-01 (the RLS bypass settings must be removed for the new policies to be a real control). The launch-scope registry (shared/constants/launch-scope.ts) must keep reg-change out until steps 2-6 land.
